raw_response:
I'll think through this as the farmer and give the plan.

---

My thinking:

I am old, 70 years. I only started to farm one year ago — before this I did not work the land myself. So I watch my neighbors very close. What they do, I do. That is the safest way. A bad harvest on 6 mu with 7 mouths at home is a real problem.

My 6 mu — 4 mu I plant wheat in winter, then maize on same land in summer. That is how everyone around me farms. The other 2 mu, I keep 1 mu for cotton and 1 mu for stevia. Stevia is new for me, but a man two houses down has been growing it and the buyer comes to the village, so I follow him.

For fertilizer I buy from the town shop. The shopkeeper sells compound fertilizer 复合肥 and urea 尿素. One bag is 50 jin, which is 25 kg. My neighbor told me: for wheat, put 2 bags compound fertilizer under the ground before planting, then 1 bag urea in spring when wheat starts to grow tall. Same for maize, 2 bags compound before, 1 bag urea when knee-high. I do the same. I would rather use one bag more than one bag less — if I save 30 yuan on fertilizer and lose 100 jin of grain, that is stupid.

Cotton eats a lot of medicine — bollworm comes every year. I must spray 4, maybe 5 times. My neighbor sprays, I spray the same day. Stevia I don't spray much, just once or twice, the leaves are what we sell so I am careful.

Water — I have well. Wheat must water 2-3 times in spring, everyone says so. Maize — if summer rain is good, one time is enough. Cotton I water 2 times. Stevia needs water often, maybe 4 times, it is a green leaf crop.

Seeds — I buy the same seed packet my neighbor buys. Hybrid maize from the shop. Wheat seed I saved a little but also bought the improved kind the village promotes. Cotton hybrid seed. Stevia seedlings I buy from the man who buys the leaves.

For plowing, I hire the tractor — everyone in the village hires the same man. He does rotary 旋耕 for wheat and maize. For cotton he plows deeper.

My yield I don't dare hope too high. First year I just want what my neighbors get. Wheat 900 jin, maize a bit over 1000 jin, cotton 500 jin seed cotton, stevia dry leaf maybe 600 jin.
